data.name: Shutter
data.detailed_description:
You were on your way to a photography gig for a wedding event when a flat tire brings your trip to a sudden halt. While your boyfriend stays behind to fix the vehicle, you spot a sign for a nearby lake and decide to explore the forest trail. Armed with your camera and a walkie-talkie, you venture into the dense trees and rocky paths to capture some nature shots while you wait.

What begins as a simple detour to a serene lake quickly turns tense and unsettling. As you explore, you discover scattered mysterious tape records left by a retired scientist. Each tape uncovers the forest’s dark secrets, guiding you deeper into the wilderness and closer to danger.

The forest is alive with eerie phenomena: distorted audio over your walkie-talkie, sudden noises, birds bursting from the trees, and a secret cult that seem to watch your every move. Use your skills as a photographer to document wildlife, strange occurrences, and unsettling sights. All the while, you must navigate a tense relationship with your boyfriend; his voice over the walkie-talkie can be a source of comfort or a growing point of frustration.

Keep a sharp eye out for hidden collectibles, like a few elusive ducks that unlock a special Easter egg. But be warned: the deeper you go, the closer you come to a monstrous presence. Your detour to the lake is about to culminate in a chilling and unforgettable climax.

Key Features:

  • Atmospheric first-person horror adventure set in a vast 1980s forest.

  • Photography-based gameplay: capture wildlife, clues, and eerie occurrences.

  • Explore the forest while discovering tapes that reveal hidden stories.

  • Tense, immersive audio design with distorted walkie-talkie communication.

  • Subtle collectibles and Easter eggs for players who explore carefully.

  • A story-driven experience with psychological and jump-scare elements.

Experience Shutter — a haunting journey through nature, narrative, and fear, where every photograph could be your last.
